items.title: Unit 14 · Action Boy can run!
items.scene: This is a very big cat. It has got orange and black stripes. It can swim. It can climb trees. It can jump. And it can run very fast. This animal likes meat. You can see it at the zoo. What is it? It is a tiger. This is a bird. It is blue, green, red and yellow. It can fly and it can sing. It can't read and write. But it can talk! This animal likes fruit and nuts. It can be a pet in a house. What is it? It is a parrot.
items.hint: Look carefully. Listen again, then check your answer.
items.why: Which animal has stripes? the tiger. Check the detail in “Beautiful animals”.
